name: Voxel Grid Editing (Add/Remove)
definition: A method to dynamically modify the voxel grid by adding or removing individual voxels at specific positions determined by raycasting.
summary: Voxel Grid Editing (Add/Remove) enables real-time sculpting by translating 2D mouse clicks into 3D voxel changes via raycasting and grid snapping, differing from bulk tools by focusing on single-voxel operations.
